GitHub - dueyama/gray-scott-3d: Interactive 3D Gray-Scott reaction ...
The Gray-Scott model is a reaction-diffusion system in which autocatalytic reaction terms and diffusion can generate rich spatial patterns. This app focuses on the three-dimensional case and renders regions where the concentration of V becomes visible. The goal is public exploration rather than research-grade numerical analysis.
